name: Power over Poison
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
You've learned what it means to cure poison without the benefit of spiritual aid.  Remember what others must endure in fighting poisonous afflictions as you soon embrace your newfound power over poison.

You should now return to Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff, adventurer.  He, no doubt, has a very important spell to teach you now that the student understands the lesson given unto  him .

Farewell, young druid.  We shall speak again.
narrative.objectives: Return to Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise, Thunder Bluff.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Welcome back - I've been following your progress on this lesson since you left, and I must admit I was surprised to learn about the situation at the Crossroads. This does bear some further investigation, as the introduction of such poisons into the environment is most upsetting to the balance.

You handled yourself with grace under pressure. For that, I can find no better way to reward you with permanent power over poison. Use it well, adventurer... use it well.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests at level 14, 3,325 XP in all.

quests.name: Lessons Anew
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

quests.name: The Principal Source
quests.objectiveText: Use the Empty Dreadmist Peak Sampler to draw a sample of water from a pool at the top of the peak. Deliver the Filled Dreadmist Peak Sampler to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads

quests.name: Gathering the Cure
quests.objectiveText: Bring 5 Earthroot and 5 Kodo Horns to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads so he may make a curative salve.

quests.name: Curing the Sick
quests.objectiveText: Use the Curative Animal Salve on 10 Sickly Gazelles that are located throughout the northern part of the Barrens; doing so should cure them.

quests.name: Power over Poison
quests.objectiveText: Return to Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise, Thunder Bluff.
